project_title: Smart Farmer Procurement Slot Booking & Queue Management System (SIH 2026 SIH26032)
hero_tagline: Smart Procurement. Less Waiting. Better Service.

typography.body_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Noto Sans Devanagari, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.caption: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium tracking-wide uppercase

colors.theme_type: Light Theme Priority (Warm Organic Govt Palette)
colors.gradient_rule: NO dark gradients or full-page saturated AI gradients. Use solid earth tones, crisp 1px borders (#DDD8C7), subtle layered shadows, and organic grain backgrounds.

layout_and_grid.spacing_philosophy: Generous 2x-3x padding scale (p-6, p-8, p-12). Containers with borders must have internal padding.
layout_and_grid.bento_grid_mode: Tetris Grid for Landing, High Density Grid for Staff & Admin Dashboards
layout_and_grid.header_nav: Sticky header with glassmorphism backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F7F5EE]/90 border-b border-[#DDD8C7] z-50
layout_and_grid.footer: Dark forest background (#163418) with massive typographic anchor, fast contact links, and govt helpline details

landing_page.hero_section: Bold headline ('Smart Procurement. Less Waiting. Better Service.'), Hindi toggle button (EN | हिंदी), dual CTA (Book Procurement Slot / Check Live Queue Status), quick status lookup widget.
landing_page.features_grid: 3x3 asymmetrical bento displaying Real-time Queue, Multi-Commodity Slot Booking, Verification & Payment Timeline, Direct SMS Alerts.
landing_page.live_stats_banner: Live counters for Total Quintals Procured, Active Centres, Average Wait Time, Farmers Served Today.

farmer_dashboard.active_token_card: Tactile high-contrast card showing Token No. (e.g., #TK-2026-8942), Centre Name, Allocated Date & Time, Assigned Bay.
farmer_dashboard.live_queue_monitor: Large numeric badge for Currently Serving Token, 'Farmers Ahead of You' live counter, Estimated Waiting Time (mins/hrs).
farmer_dashboard.procurement_timeline_stepper: Vertical 7-step tracker: 1. Slot Booked -> 2. Arrived at Centre -> 3. Token Verified -> 4. Moisture & Quality Check -> 5. Weighing Completed -> 6. Payment Sanctioned -> 7. Direct Bank Transfer (DBT) Paid.
farmer_dashboard.slot_booking_wizard: 5-Step Wizard: 1. Select Procurement Centre (Map/District filter) -> 2. Choose Commodity (Wheat, Paddy, Gram, Mustard) -> 3. Select Date -> 4. Choose Time Slot Grid -> 5. Enter Quantity (Quintals) & Vehicle No. -> Confirmation Token Receipt PDF/Print.

staff_dashboard.today_overview: 4 KPI Cards: Queue Capacity, Tokens Called, Pending Weighments, Total Procured Today.
staff_dashboard.queue_control_panel: Primary Action: 'Call Next Farmer' (sound chime toggle + SMS ping), Live Queue Table with quick status switches (Mark Arrived, Start Verification, Record Weight, Complete Slot, Escalate Issue).
staff_dashboard.weighbridge_entry_modal: Fast numeric keypad input for Gross Weight, Tare Weight, Net Weight & Moisture % with auto MSP payout calculation.

admin_dashboard.analytics_charts: Recharts visualising Procurement Volume by Commodity, District-wide Queue Efficiency, Daily Farmer Footfall, Payment Clearance Velocity.
admin_dashboard.centre_and_slot_management: CRUD table for Centres, capacity sliders per slot, slot blackout days, MSP rates manager.

component_guidelines.ui_library: Shadcn UI primitives with custom Tailwind classes in light earth palette
component_guidelines.selects_dropdowns: Shadcn Select/Dropdown Menu (never native HTML selects)
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill or rounded-xl buttons with subtle hover lift (-translate-y-0.5) and crisp ring focus states
component_guidelines.testing_data_testid: MANDATORY. Every interactive button, input, link, tab, modal trigger, card, status badge, and stepper step MUST have data-testid in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this design_guidelines.json file first before generating any UI.
2. Ensure all text and labels have complete English and Hindi translations toggleable via top navbar state.
3. Enforce strictly light earthy theme with deep green #1E4620, terracotta #B85B28, sand background #F7F5EE, and crisp white cards.
4. Ensure every button, input, tab, select, modal trigger, step item, and status element has a dedicated data-testid attribute.
5. Provide mock data for 5+ Procurement Centres, 10+ Farmers in Queue, 4 Commodities (Wheat, Paddy, Gram, Mustard) with MSP prices, and 7-stage Procurement Timeline.
6. Include interactive simulation controls on Staff Dashboard so clicking 'Call Next Token' actively updates the Farmer Queue state in real time.
